# Astropy Toolkit

Curated by Skill Harbor — the deepest Astropy skill in this lot: a complete working reference for the core Python astronomy library, covering units and quantities (with equivalencies and logarithmic units), celestial coordinate transforms (ICRS, Galactic, FK5, AltAz, proper motions), FITS I/O, table operations (cross-matching, filtering, joins), precise time systems (UTC/TAI/TT/TDB, JD/MJD), WCS pixel-to-sky mapping, and cosmology (Planck18 distances, ages, lookback times) — with quick-start snippets and pointers to deep-dive reference files for each subsystem. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @k-dense-ai. Honest caveats: requires Python 3.11+ with astropy installed; a few features (object name resolution, remote FITS reads, IERS updates) need network access; 1,634 installs on the catalog, but popularity is not a review. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
